title: SMTO-UI-0049 — Palette launcher unavailable
summary: You ran the command that opens the SMTO Command Palette, but your computer didn't confirm that a web browser opened it. Nothing was sent to SMTO.
html:
SMTO-UI-0049 — Palette launcher unavailable

GUID: 615e8b14-376c-5b21-838b-0832279da6f9
Slug: palette-launcher-unavailable
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • You ran the command that opens the SMTO Command Palette, but your computer didn't confirm that a web browser opened it. Nothing was sent to SMTO.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Set a default web browser in your computer's system settings, then run aor palette again. The command asks your computer's default browser to open the palette, and fails if none is set up.
  2. Make sure SMTO itself is running (start it with ./startup.sh or the installed app) before running aor palette. The palette is a page served by SMTO, so it can only open while SMTO is running.
  3. If the browser still won't open by itself, open your SMTO address in the browser and add /agent-ui?palette=1&ui=desktop to the end. This opens the same Command Palette directly without the launcher.
  4. Inside SMTO you can also select the Command palette button at any time. The in-app button works without any system shortcut.

What success looks like

  • Running aor palette prints that it opened the Command Palette and the palette appears in your browser.

If it still fails

  • Copy the code and text the command printed and send them to the person who installed SMTO. Don't turn on Input Monitoring or install a keyboard hook to open the palette; SMTO doesn't need either.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The aor palette CLI command could not open the Command Palette URL because webbrowser.open returned false or raised an error.

What this means

  • The CLI browser-opening attempt returns false when launching the Command Palette URL. This presentation or validation result does not establish an external task outcome. Use the saved run, resource revision and receipts when deciding whether an action can safely be repeated.

Why this can happen

  • The CLI browser-opening attempt returns false when launching the Command Palette URL.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect default-browser configuration and the constructed runtime URL separately from server health.

How to fix it

  • The palette command in src/agent_runtime/api/cli.py builds <base>/agent-ui?palette=1&ui=desktop and calls webbrowser.open; this error means no usable browser controller was found (check $BROWSER, xdg-open or the OS default browser) or launching it failed. Configure a default browser, confirm the Server is running at the URL (or pass --url), or open the palette URL manually.
  • Configure a default browser, ensure the runtime is running, then run aor palette again or open /agent-ui?palette=1&ui=desktop at your runtime URL.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the invocation configuration before trying again.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended palette URL opens in a browser connected to the running service.

What not to do

  • Do not enable Input Monitoring or a keyboard hook to invoke the palette.

Technical notes
